Issue 20:
# 20 — Extract filterProducts pure function

Status: needs-triage
Type: AFK

## What to build

Gallery's search + tag filter logic lives as a `useMemo` inside the render tree. It's a pure data transform but is coupled to React state, making it untestable without mounting the full component. Extract `filterProducts(products, { query, tag })` to `src/lib/products.js` so it can be tested exhaustively with zero React setup.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `src/lib/products.js` exports `filterProducts(products, { query, tag })` returning the filtered array
- [ ] Filtering rules: `query` matches name, description, or any tag (case-insensitive substring); `tag` is exact-match on the tags array; both conditions must be met when both are set; empty/null values for either are treated as no filter
- [ ] `Gallery.jsx` delegates its `useMemo` filter to `filterProducts` — no inline filter logic remains in the component
- [ ] Unit tests cover: search by name, search by description, search by tag text, tag pill filter, combined search+tag, empty query returns all, no match returns empty array
- [ ] No existing tests broken

## Blocked by

- 19 (both write to `src/lib/products.js` — sequential to avoid merge conflict)

plan.sprint_goal: Extract filterProducts as a tested pure function in src/lib/products.js and update Gallery.jsx to delegate filtering to it

dev1.task: Update Gallery.jsx to import and delegate its useMemo filter logic to filterProducts from src/lib/products.js. Remove all inline filter logic from the component. Ensure the component still works correctly with search query and tag pill state from useGalleryFilter hook.
dev1.context_needed: src/pages/Gallery.jsx (current useMemo filter logic to be replaced), src/hooks/useGalleryFilter.js (exposes query and tag state), src/lib/products.js (will export filterProducts after Dev2 implements it — coordinate on function signature: filterProducts(products, { query, tag }))

dev2.task: Implement and fully test filterProducts(products, { query, tag }) in src/lib/products.js and write exhaustive unit tests in src/lib/products.test.js. Rules: query matches name, description, or any element of tags array (case-insensitive substring); tag is exact-match against tags array; both conditions must be ANDed when both are set; empty string, null, or undefined for either param is treated as no filter for that dimension.
dev2.context_needed: src/lib/products.js (existing file — check what is already exported to avoid overwriting or conflicting exports), src/lib/products.test.js (existing test file — add new tests without breaking existing ones). Product shape from DB/CartContext: { id, name, description, price, image_url, tags: string[], is_available }

plan.shared_types: Product shape: { id: string, name: string, description: string, price: number, image_url: string, tags: string[], is_available: boolean }. filterProducts signature: (products: Product[], filters: { query?: string | null, tag?: string | null }) => Product[]
